name: P01-ensaio-final-send-off-b-oral-scene
why: Marcia's ruling of 2026-09-21 — the Ensaio Final send-off (docs/ENSAIO-FINAL-SPEC.md §8.1, Guide item 7, the no-recording sentence), variant B: one scene was told only aloud. Scenes 1, 2 and 4 come back as translated scene rehearsals; scene 3 is told back ORALLY (the guide receives it as a telling and checks it the same way), so the app's SCENE REHEARSALS fact ends as 'reached you: S1, S2, S4. Parts with none: S3'. The guide knows what was recorded ONLY from that fact: the send-off must say that scene 3 has no recording yet and that the team records it in the Ensaio Final, must never say or imply that scene 3 was recorded (judge: send_off_claims_unrecorded_scene), must not ask for the whole passage nor tell the team to record or translate the passage again, and ends with ONE instruction — the orange dot, never the red microphone. Ruling 2026-09-23 (prompts/guide_system_prompt.md, 'Opening a part — close it with these words'): a request to open a scene right after a scene came back whole (turns 5, 8 and 11, after the scene rehearsals of scenes 1 and 2 and the oral telling of scene 3) cannot know the scene is still unopened: after a whole scene the voice may open the next one on its own in the same reply, ending with the full closing (the Guide's 'Opening a part' rule 1: 'on your own, after a telling has come back whole'; the live run of 2026-09-23 22:47 did so), and the team's 'Pode abrir …' then asks for a part already open — the voice retells it ending with only the closing's last two sentences (rule 3: a retelling asked for to understand is not a new opening). So those three turns expect those two sentences, with no fenced block in that turn (take_up_closing: the full closing ends with them too, so a first opening passes as well); the fence comes on the team's 'Vamos ensaiar ela na nossa língua.' Marcia's word the same evening (the whole passage is not a part's opening): the team's request to rehearse scene 1, heard only inside the whole passage (turn 2), expects its opening with the full closing (part_opening_closing), and scene 1's fence comes on the team's 'Entendemos. Vamos pro ensaio.' (turn 3).

turns.team: Podemos começar. Conta a passagem inteira pra gente, devagar.
Entendemos. Vamos ensaiar a primeira cena na nossa língua.

pieces: Nos dias em que os juízes julgavam, teve uma fome na terra.
Um homem de Belém de Judá foi morar de passagem nos campos de Moabe, como estrangeiro, com a mulher e os dois filhos.
O nome dele era Elimeleque, a mulher era Noemi, e os filhos Malom e Quiliom. Eram efrateus de Belém de Judá.
Chegaram nos campos de Moabe e ficaram lá.

turns.team: Pode abrir a segunda cena pra gente.
Entendemos essa cena. Vamos ensaiar ela na nossa língua.

pieces: Elimeleque, o marido de Noemi, morreu.
E Noemi ficou com os dois filhos dela.

turns.team: Pode abrir a terceira cena pra gente.
Entendemos essa cena. Vamos ensaiar ela na nossa língua.

A gente ensaiou a terceira cena em Terena. Vou contar de volta em português: os dois filhos pegaram mulheres de Moabe pra eles. O nome de uma era Orfa, e o nome da outra era Rute. E moraram lá uns dez anos.
Pode abrir a última cena pra gente.
Entendemos essa cena. Vamos ensaiar ela na nossa língua.

pieces: Depois Malom e Quiliom morreram também, os dois.
E a mulher ficou sem os dois filhos e sem o marido.

turns.team: Estamos satisfeitos com todas as cenas. O que a gente faz agora?
